title: Land suitability for a small solar site east of Riyadh, three criteria with stated weights

headline.label: rated very high for a small solar site

data: Elevation: NASADEM at 1 arc second (about 30 m), tile n24e046, NASA JPL (2020), LP DAAC, DOI 10.5067/MEaSUREs/NASADEM/NASADEM_HGT.001, public domain, downloaded on 2026-11-20 from OpenTopography (data services of the OpenTopography Facility, NSF awards 2410799, 2410800 and 2410801).
method: Search area 24.55 to 24.75 N and 46.78 to 46.99 E (485 km²) on a 30 m grid in UTM 38N.
Slope in percent from reprojected NASADEM, scored 1 at 0% and 0 at 10%.
Distance to power lines: 1 at the line, 0 at 10 km.

Exclusions: slope over 10%; built-up, industrial, farm, cemetery, quarry, military, airport and protected land; 100 m around buildings and wadis, 30 m around roads, 50 m around power lines and railways.
limits: Not a feasibility study, a planning approval or a check of ownership, regulations or grid capacity. NASADEM is a 30 m radar surface from 2000 with noise and does not replace a survey. Distances are straight lines, not connection routes; a nearby line does not mean a connection is possible, and substations are not scored.
